note: Made-up examples in the shape of the course's practice messages (one act each).

practice.text: The build cache is stale after the upgrade. Please `purge_cache`.
The weekly report is final. `archive_report` it, please.
The hotfix is reviewed. `release_hold` so it ships tonight.
The disk alert on node 3 is known and handled. `ack_alert`.
The deploy key may have leaked. `rotate_key` now.
Tell the team the outage is over: `post_status`.
